Steps: (1) copy ../ReiPan/src/reipan to src/rosepan and ../ReiPan/src/sdk to src/sdk; rename ReiPan_ / REIPAN_ / reipan_ identifiers, env variables and file names to RosePan_ / ROSEPAN_ / rosepan_, keeping the tool contract in tools/reverse/README.md 'Platform contract' (ROSEPAN_SHOT_DIR / ROSEPAN_SHOT_EVERY screenshots of the presented frame, ROSEPAN_AUTOPAD scripted pad in sdk/libpad.cpp, ROSEPAN_DATA_DIR, the RosePanGame thread name, the stub log line). (4) CMakeLists.txt, CMakePresets.json, cmake/*.cmake and resources/ (shaders) from ReiPan with ReiPan renamed RosePan: target RosePan, output cmake-build-*/RosePan/RosePan.exe, the sibling extern fallback pointed at ../ReiPan/extern then ../MioPan/extern (FFmpeg, shadercross), -fno-strict-aliasing and the src/sdk/pc_prefix.h force-include kept, every .c/.cpp compiled as C++. (6) python build.py green; python build.py --run 15 writes work/shots/last.png (look at it); python layoutcheck.py runs clean. Keep platform edits minimal and list them in the summary; record the layer's shape in architecture.md 'PC platform layer' and anything that burned time in hazards.md.
